scope: A focused serial-host regression alternates the built-in mesh_refinement/dens_max threshold across restart continuations to force three refine and three derefine transitions with cosmic-ray particles. Successful transitions exercise retained particle ownership refresh; particle snapshots gate finite state, stable count and tag identity, valid ownership, ownership changes across every AMR transition, and same-level physical MeshBlock migration.

bounded_evidence_limits.mpi: open: this tranche is intentionally serial-host only and does not exercise rank-to-rank particle transfer, decomposition changes, or MPI interruption handling
bounded_evidence_limits.memory_checking: open: run the repeated-transition tranche under ASan, UBSan, Valgrind, or an equivalent host memory checker
bounded_evidence_limits.hip: open: run the repeated-transition lifetime stress with the supported Frontier HIP GPU toolchain and retain registered evidence
bounded_evidence_limits.coupled_boundary: open: this tranche uses periodic boundaries and test-particle feedback; coupled feedback with supported non-periodic boundary combinations remains to be exercised
bounded_evidence_limits.scientific_amr: open: this engineering lifetime regression is not Section 5.3 AMR scientific qualification
